### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

`qos/test_qos_dscp_mapping.py` skip condition matching has a regression where testcase specific skip conditions are not matching.

This is because the test has been changed to include the DUT name in the test param - the current skip condition does not account for any additional characters aside from the test parameter itself.
i.e. `[pipe]` vs `[pipe-dutname]`

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/f53e10146340daf7f94d0a4e1efb7b78334ba91a/tests/common/plugins/conditional_mark/tests_mark_conditions.yaml#L3778

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `qos/test_qos_dscp_mapping.py::TestQoSSaiDSCPQueueMapping_IPIP_Base::test_dscp_to_queue_mapping` in `sonic-mgmt` and see the test not skipping on platforms where it expects to skip (i.e. `Broadcom` for the `[pipe]` variant).

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Current behavior:

`qos/test_qos_dscp_mapping.py::TestQoSSaiDSCPQueueMapping_IPIP_Base::test_dscp_to_queue_mapping[pipe*` does not skip on `Broadcom` platforms.

Expected behavior:
The test should be skipped.

resolution.title: Fix bad skip condition on qos/test_qos_dscp_mapping.py test cases
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Currently, the skip conditions are done with square brackets before and after the test param.
i.e. `[pipe]`, and `[uniform]`.

This does not match when testing on an actual DUT, as the DUT name is appended to the test param as:
`[pipe-gd450]` and `[uniform-gd450]`.

Fixing this mismatch by removing the closing square brackets.

Fixes #24243
